baseline.experiment: remove direct sharp from root package only, retain old glTF Transform 4.3.0, then npm install --package-lock-only and npm audit --package-lock-only

candidate.experiment: update glTF Transform packages to 4.5.1, ndarray-pixels 5.2.0, sharp 0.35.5 and generate native npm lockfile, then audit

context: Observed M2 npm resolution experiments, Nov 6 2026; baseline is a removal-only attempted lock, not the historic repository which had no lock
limits: This benchmark is one frozen resolution per variant, not vulnerability likelihood
Deprecation risk and other Node 18 compatibility must be checked separately
GitHub Dependabot alert closure occurs asynchronously after lockfile merge
A later advisory or transitive update can change npm audit counts
